questions.cardText:
[Anthropology] How does a traditional Tibetan burial work?
A. The body is set on fire and sent down a river on a ceremonial raft
B. The body is strapped to a yak and sent into the wilderness
C. The body is left to be consumed by birds of prey
Answer: C. This practice, also known as sky burial, is rooted in Vajrayana Buddhism, which teaches the transience of life and the importance of returning the body to nature. This method also serves practical purposes, given the region’s rocky terrain and scarcity of wood for cremation.
questions.de: Wovon lässt man bei einer traditionellen tibetischen Himmelsbestattung den Leichnam verzehren?
questions.en: In a traditional Tibetan sky burial, by what is the body left to be consumed?

timeline.labelEn: The Cultural Revolution, during which sky burial was banned in China as one of the Four Olds
timeline.labelDe: Die Kulturrevolution, während der die Himmelsbestattung in China als eines der „Vier Alten“ verboten war

questions.notes: Card correct: Tibetan bya gtor ('bird-scattered') leaves the corpse on a mountaintop to be eaten by scavengers, especially vultures and crows (Wikipedia: Sky burial); rocky ground and scarce fuel and timber made it more practical than cremation. Wikipedia says Vajrayana teaches the transmigration of spirits (the body becomes an empty vessel) rather than the card's 'transience of life'. Vultures are scavengers, loosely 'birds of prey'. Timeline: the Cultural Revolution (1966–1976, Wikipedia: Cultural Revolution), when sky burial was banned.

questions.cardText:
[Physics] What is the fundamental unit of electric charge?
A. Ampere B. Volt C. Coulomb
Answer: C.
questions.de: Wie heißt die SI-Einheit der elektrischen Ladung, die der Ladung entspricht, die ein Strom von 1 Ampere in 1 Sekunde transportiert?
questions.en: What is the SI unit of electric charge, equal to the charge carried by a current of 1 ampere in 1 second?

timeline.labelEn: Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, French physicist after whom the unit of charge is named
timeline.labelDe: Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, französischer Physiker und Namensgeber der Einheit der Ladung

questions.notes: Card wording loose: the coulomb is the SI unit of electric charge (Wikipedia: Coulomb), but it is a derived unit (1 C = 1 A·s); the 'fundamental' quantum of charge is the elementary charge e = 1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C. Asked as the SI unit. Coulomb's dates from Wikipedia: Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.
